items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: And you had a Jimmy Westbrook out of, what's the name of that, Waco, Texas. And that's the one where Herschel was with them. He was called the T&T Band. ... And Jimmy Westbrook was playing the drums.

ctx.x: And who did he play with? Tren? Mostly with Tren. Tren. That was the only band I've known God I'd ever play with.
And you had a Jimmy Westbrook out of, what's the name of that, Waco, Texas. And that's the one where Herschel was with them. He was called the T&T Band.
Yeah, I was going to ask you about that band. You were talking about the Tren. Right.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: The name of this band was the TNT band and Jimmy Westbrook was the drummer, he's a left-handed drummer. He's now living in Los Angeles

ctx.x: Well what about Herschel Evans then? Was he a good reader when he came?

No, Herschel couldn't read music. How I met Herschel Evans, I was getting ready to leave here and they used to have the Dixie Series and there was a band that Herschel came here with, with a team from Wichita Falls that year. The name of this band was the TNT band and Jimmy Westbrook was the drummer, he's a left-handed drummer. He's now living in Los Angeles and Herschel was playing alto and playing a date up at the old Pelican ball and I met Herschel then and we all left on the same train. I was going to Dallas…
